summary: Transforms three color components at a1 (offsets 0x0/0x4/0x8) through a flag-selected matrix/thunk pipeline. A switch on the combined presence of flags a4/a5/a6 selects whether a transform thunk runs once (cases 3/5/6), twice (case 7), or not at all; a second transform thunk always runs. When blend data a3 is present, each component is blended against per-channel offset/scale values read from a3. Returns a1.

local_names.a1: three-component color vector to transform and return

operations.description: Switch on (a4!=0) | 2*((a5!=0) | 2*(a6!=0)) backed by jump table jpt_50EA25: cases 3, 5 and 6 call the conditional thunk once, case 7 calls it twice, default (none or single flag) calls it not at all
ThunkToFUN0050cba3() runs once for switch cases 3/5/6 and twice for case 7; it is the conditional color-transform step
ThunkToThunkFUN0050c5b0() runs unconditionally after the switch; it is the always-applied color-transform step
Blend applies only when a3 is non-null
Return the transformed a1 color vector
